craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of sealing — utsāha as measure, course, denial, seal land in turn. Chiefs multiply, unity multiplies: other-chief-other-unity; horse/man examples kept. Rejected: (a) one-unity universal → killed: plurality is the verse. (b) horse→elephant modernize → killed: vighna. Read aloud: SO-by an-OTH-er-CHIEF — WHAT-oth-er U-ni-ty … THE-king's-HORSE, MAN.

lines: So by another chief — what other unity, or by still another —
secondaries called relation: the king's horse, man.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tathānyena pradhānena yaikatānyāpareṇa vā saṃbandhākhyā guṇasya syādrājño'śvaḥ puruṣo

reads_against.argmap: What other unity? → Other chiefs, other unities: secondary's relation-called — king's horse, man.
c1_essence: Secondaries measured against chiefs — king's man, brahmin's; other chiefs, other unities — king's horse, man (vv19-20).
Course told, delusion denied, seal spoken: Māyā-knower-resting intellects drive transaction, moment-grounded in self-awareness; told, proved, unrefuted, useful, full apparatus besides (vv21-23).
